name: cohorts-losses-no-hire
about: Q-AD34: a mature cohort with no hire and losses after conversion, beside young ones; the brief must not invent a qualified count.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign running, delivering 7 leads at $30.64 each from $214.50 in spend.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet produced 10,230 impressions, 152 clicks, and a 1.5% click rate — all figures match the day totals since it was the sole campaign.
November 2026 is 27 days in with $214.50 spent so far, all of it on Meta.

The 2026-10-05 cohort is mature at 19 leads: 15 were contacted (78.9%), 5 converted to applicants (26.3%), 3 filed applications (15.8%), and 4 ended after conversion without a hire (21.1%) — no one has been hired from this group yet.
The 2026-10-19 cohort has 23 leads — 17 contacted, 6 converted, 2 applied, 1 lost after conversion, and no hires — but it is too young to judge by rates.
The 2026-11-02 cohort has 7 leads with only 3 contacted and no conversions yet; it is also too young to judge.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
